## Type

- [ ] Data (facts)
- [ ] Code / tooling
- [ ] Docs

## Data checklist (data PRs)

- [ ] Every new or changed value has an official source URL
- [ ] `retrieved_at` date (YYYY-MM-DD) is set
- [ ] Academic year is 2026/27 or 2025/26 (latest only)
- [ ] No copied prose, logos or photos
- [ ] `npm run data:check` passes locally

## Code checklist (code PRs)

- [ ] Tests added or updated, `node --import tsx --test tests/*.test.ts` passes
- [ ] `npx tsc --noEmit` and `npm run lint` pass
- [ ] Commits signed off (`git commit -s`)
- [ ] No secrets or personal data
